note: Illustrative programme status content aligned to project RAG status and commentary in projects.json. projectIds link items to projects so the summary follows the dashboard filters; items without projectIds are programme-wide.

highlights.text: ServiceNow to Jira Service Management migration on track for the October 2026 cutover; configuration complete.
Identity workstreams mobilised: SailPoint ISC and CyberArk cloud designs progressing to plan.
SIEM replacement (Phase I) and SOAR automation (Phase II) aligned under a single roadmap.

lowlights.text: New Call Centre Onboarding is Red: vendor delay in office fit-out is holding up premises readiness.
AD to Entra ID Phase I sequencing affected by legacy application dependencies and hybrid identity complexity.
CRM integration complexity and market rollout dependencies under active review.

risksIssues.text: Call centre premises fit-out delayed by vendor, impacting infrastructure installation, workplace readiness and the onboarding schedule.
Legacy AD dependencies could push Entra ID Phase I completion beyond December 2027.
Firewall rule complexity and site-specific dependencies may delay full network segmentation.
CRM market rollout dependencies could compress the 2028 rollout window.

nextSteps.text: Agree recovery plan and revised fit-out dates with the call centre premises vendor.
Complete Jira SM UAT sign-off and confirm cutover readiness for 30 October.
Present SailPoint ISC target design to the design authority (October 2026).
Finish the hybrid identity dependency assessment and re-baseline migration waves.

decisionsNeeded.text: Approve the call centre re-plan and an interim workplace option if fit-out slips further.
Confirm SIEM platform selection to protect the Phase I timeline (November 2026).
Endorse CRM pilot market choice and SAP E1 integration sequencing.
